source:
We are Cerim, holy warriors sworn to vanquish the ancient Pestilence. Summoned to the backwater isle of Sacra, our ship was sunk enroute by a rebel group known as the Risen. We washed ashore and made our way to the capital city of Sacrament, where we learned the truth we feared most – the Pestilence has returned. 

Inside the city's gates, we met Governor Ellsworth and Baron Winnick. But no sooner had we reached the Watcher - the man who summoned us - when an envoy from Phalen arrived. Madrigal Seline, leader of the Inquisition, informed Ellsworth that his brother, King Harol, has died. The crown passes to his nephew, Magnus. 

The Madrigal then presented Ellsworth with his captured daughter Odessa - the Risen rebel who led the raiding party on our ship. As Ellsworth and the Madrigal depart for the holy city of Caylen, we are left to contemplate our next move.
